No exposed pipes/cables, skeleton frames, cages, thin rods, decorative frameworks, hanging chains, spikes, skulls or demonic motifs. No modeled rivets, weapons or bolt-on cargo containers. Form changes must read without color changes.

SHEET:
Warm ivory LANDSCAPE 3:2 board matching BF02. Upper left LARGE complete FRONT 3/4, upper right LARGE complete REAR 3/4, lower row SIDE + TOP + REAR orthographic. TOP must be a true flat overhead projection with exact mirrored edges, nose left; no perspective masquerading as top. Same structure and proportions in all views, identical cabin scale and engine count. Clear neutral lighting, no scenery or flames, no alternate ships within the sheet. Title contains the new variant ID; simple view labels.
